reply: Danke, dass du die Probleme mit VoiceOver so genau beschreibst. Unzugängliche Dialoge, ein ausgebremstes VoiceOver und Truhen, die Bilder voraussetzen, sollten eine Lern-App nicht unbenutzbar machen. Schick die Details bitte an {support_contact}, damit das Team sie gezielt prüfen kann.

Lamentamos que tu curso de música volviera a empezar desde cero después de salir a la tienda a mitad de la clase. Escríbenos a {support_contact} con tu dispositivo y la versión de la app para que el equipo revise tu progreso.

Danke für dein Feedback. Wir verstehen, dass Schatztruhen und andere Extras nerven, wenn du eigentlich nur die Lektion machen möchtest. Deinen Wunsch, so etwas abschalten zu können, geben wir an das Team weiter.
ご家族で励まし合いながら続けていただいているとのこと、嬉しいです。「部屋を替えてもらえません」の例のように、不正解の理由が分からないと意欲に影響することはよく理解できます。解説の充実や、幼児向けのひらがな表示・フォニックスのご提案もチームに共有いたします。

Thank you for sharing your concern as a parent. We understand you want to decide what content your daughter sees, and we've shared your feedback with the team. You can also reach us at {support_contact} with questions about course content.

Sorry you can't get into the app, especially with your 19-day streak going. Since updating didn't help, please contact {support_contact} with your device model and iOS version so the team can help you get back to your lessons.

Obrigado pelo feedback detalhado e por reportar a questão com "Anna"! Entendemos que perder toda a energia em uma questão sem erros é frustrante e que você preferia as vidas. Compartilhamos sua opinião com a equipe.
Schade, dass du so viele fehlerhafte Übersetzungen findest und das Melden bisher nichts gebracht hat. Schick uns gern konkrete Beispiele an {support_contact}, damit das Team sie gezielt prüfen kann.

Sorry the app got stuck on "course building" for 30 minutes when you were excited to start. Please contact {support_contact} with your device and app version so the team can help you get your course working.

Danke für dein Feedback! Wir verstehen, dass es umständlich ist, Schwedisch über Englisch lernen zu müssen, und dass Truhen und Sammelspiele wie Zeitverschwendung wirken. Beides geben wir an das Team weiter.
再びご利用いただきありがとうございます。レッスンを終えたのに翌日連続記録が更新されていないこと、音声入力がうまくいかないことがあるとのこと、有料プランをご利用中なのに申し訳ありません。端末とアプリのバージョン、発生日を添えて{support_contact}までご連絡ください。

Wir verstehen, wie enttäuschend und ungerecht sich der Ausschluss vom {app_name} English Test für Menschen mit iranischem Ausweis anfühlt. Dein Feedback wurde weitergegeben. Fragen zum Zugang zum Test kannst du an {support_contact} richten.
Thank you! Math, Korean and Spanish all at once is impressive. We're so glad you love learning with {app_name}!

Parabéns pelos mais de 1.200 dias de ofensiva, e desculpe por esse problema. Se a lição não é contabilizada quando você sai antes de abrir os bônus, envie o modelo do aparelho, a versão do app e as datas para {support_contact}, para que a equipe possa verificar.

Sentimos muito que suas conquistas não estejam sendo atualizadas, ainda mais depois de você já ter reclamado várias vezes. Envie o modelo do seu aparelho e a versão do app para {support_contact}, para que a equipe possa analisar o problema.
詳しいご意見ありがとうございます。広告の多さ、ウィジェットやアイコンから感じるプレッシャー、キャラクターの演出が怖いと感じられた点はチームに共有いたします。回答が押せない問題については、端末とアプリのバージョンを添えて{support_contact}までご連絡ください。
ご意見ありがとうございます。英語を勉強したいだけなのに、連続記録やランキングについての通知が多すぎてわずらわしいとのこと、よく分かります。いただいた声はチームに共有いたします。

Thank you for such a balanced review. Running into mistakes and relying on learner reports to fix them is worrying, and we appreciate you taking the time to send feedback. Your concerns about content quality have been shared with the team.
Sorry the lessons have felt repetitive and short on useful context for you. Your feedback has been shared with the team.
Sorry {app_name} hasn't helped you learn as much as you hoped, and that losing your 128-day streak made you quit. Your feedback has been shared with the team.

Danke, schön dass du gute Fortschritte machst! Wir verstehen, dass es unfair wirkt, wenn der zweite Stern selbst fehlerfrei und schnell kaum ohne kostenpflichtige Power-ups zu schaffen ist, gerade mit der Bezahlversion. Dein Feedback geht an das Team.

Sorry to hear you've found errors in both the Spanish and the English sentences, and correct answers marked wrong. Please report specific examples in the lesson or send them to {support_contact} so they can be corrected.
Thanks for explaining why the lives system worked better for you. We understand the new energy system feels limiting even when you answer correctly, and your feedback has been shared with the team.

Que bom que você está gostando! Sentimos muito pelo bug ao promover um peão contra o Oscar. Envie o modelo do aparelho e a versão do app para {support_contact}, para que a equipe possa investigar o problema.

Poxa, perder o combo por um toque sem querer logo ao abrir o app é frustrante mesmo. Também entendemos que respostas corretas às vezes não são aceitas. Se puder, reporte esses casos na própria lição, e vamos compartilhar seu comentário com a equipe.
Danke für die fünf Sterne! Wir verstehen, dass es frustrierend ist, auf die Batterie zu warten, wenn du einfach Englisch üben möchtest. Dein Feedback geht an das Team.
Entendemos! Aprender russo sem precisar passar pelo inglês faria muito mais sentido para você. Vamos compartilhar seu pedido por um curso de russo para falantes de português com a equipe.
5年間ご利用いただきありがとうございます。オスカーの挑発的なセリフ、スキップできない長い広告、ファミリープランの繰り返しの案内、フレンドクエストの相手が自動で決まってしまう点についてのご意見は、チームに共有いたします。
Thank you! We're glad learning French with {app_name} feels easy and fun.

Danke, dass du das Problem so genau beschreibst. Laute Tonspitzen im Kopfhörer, die Ohrenschmerzen verursachen, sind nicht in Ordnung. Schick bitte dein Gerätemodell sowie die Android- und App-Version an {support_contact}, damit das Team dem Fehler nachgehen kann.
具体的なご提案ありがとうございます。同じ広告が繰り返し流れること、和訳が不自然なこと、課金の有無でリーグを分けるご提案はチームに共有いたします。マイクで文が短く認識された件は、端末とアプリのバージョンを添えて{support_contact}までお知らせください。
Sorry the shorter time on flashcards has made learning harder for you. We understand why that change feels frustrating, and your feedback has been shared with the team.
¡Gracias por tu reseña! Nos alegra que vayas bien por ahora. ¡Te deseamos mucho éxito con tu inglés!
Thanks for the recommendation, and we're glad {app_name} is helping you so much with Italian! Sorry the ads are annoying; your feedback has been shared with the team.

Thank you for the thoughtful review. We're glad {app_name} has been so helpful, and we understand the newer content feels less engaging to you than it used to. Your feedback has been shared with the team.
Sorry you're only getting 14 energy instead of 25. Please contact {support_contact} with your device and app version so the team can check what's happening with your energy.
Sorry the limit of two lessons a day makes {app_name} feel like it's pushing you toward premium. We understand the frustration, and your feedback has been shared with the team.
Sorry the reminders feel pushy instead of motivating. Your feedback has been shared with the team.

Das tut uns leid. Undeutliche Aussprache, die zu Fehlern führt, ist beim Sprachenlernen besonders ärgerlich. Zu deinem Jahresabo und der Kündigung wende dich bitte an {support_contact}, damit dein Fall geprüft werden kann.
Gracias por avisarnos. Los anuncios que piden dinero por adelantado no deberían aparecer. Por favor, envía una captura o una descripción del anuncio a {support_contact} para que pueda revisarse.
Que incrível saber que mais da metade do seu vocabulário em inglês veio daqui! Obrigado pela avaliação, e continue aprendendo.
